note: Floors from a recorded live run, 26 October 2026: provider dmr-x, model openai-fast (upstream gpt-oss-20b), eight corpus cases, scored by c011 whose PROMPT_TEMPLATE_VERSION is 1.0.0 (src/nyx/critics/llm.py) and is unchanged by this work. The runner enforces min_accuracy; max_false_positives and max_false_negatives are recorded, not enforced, until the corpus is large enough for them to mean something.

runs.notes: Before the two plumbing fixes. Three of eight cases failed as 'not valid JSON' because the provider wraps its answer in a markdown fence, which the parser treated as a refusal.

After the fence fix. No case failed as invalid JSON except one, which the model answered differently on a re-probe -- the model leg is not deterministic. The drafting-template version is irrelevant here: this run is scored by c011.

open_items: The corpus has eight cases, so one case is 0.125 of the score. The floor catches a collapse, not a drift.
The model leg abstains (returns inconclusive) on most cases. Whether that is the model or the prompt is not settled by two runs.
Re-run the corpus whenever PROMPT_TEMPLATE_VERSION changes.
